instruction: Use rsyslog to forward to logstash via JSON
output: echo 'template(name="LogstashJSON" type="list") { constant(value="{\"@timestamp\":\"") property(name="timereported" dateFormat="rfc3339") constant(value="\",\"host\":\"") property(name="hostname") constant(value="\",\"message\":\"") property(name="msg") constant(value="\"}\n"); };' > /etc/rsyslog.d/logstash.conf && echo 'action(type="omfwd" protocol="tcp" target="192.168.1.100" port="5000" template="LogstashJSON")' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/logstash.conf
